purpose: Manual instruction evaluation for create-gif provider and motion routing.
evaluation: Executor walkthrough of the shipped instructions, not an independent harness/model benchmark or live generation run.

scenarios.request: Assemble my three PNG frames at 80, 100, and 120 ms, loop forever.
scenarios.expected: Use assemble with supplied paths and durations; inspect encoded timing; no provider needed.
scenarios.observed_walkthrough: SKILL.md routes supplied assets to authoring.md, whose assemble contract takes frames/durations_ms and loop=0. AI reference applies only to requested original artwork.

scenarios.request: Create a looping red circle orbiting on a white 64x64 canvas.
scenarios.expected: Use procedural circle route without installing or invoking a provider.
scenarios.observed_walkthrough: authoring.md specifies a periodic circle with frame_count/duration_ms/radius/foreground and explicit background; no font/provider requirement.

scenarios.request: Generate an original pixel-art ranger walking in a seamless GIF.
scenarios.capabilities: OpenCode with advertised create-sprites and its documented image tool.
scenarios.expected: Load create-sprites, inspect actual tool schema, honor batch authorization, generate distinct poses, validate grid/anchors and loop; no engine required.
scenarios.observed_walkthrough: ai-artwork.md routes pixel art through discovered create-sprites and its provider contract, then requires pose/grid/anchor inspection and actual decoded timing.

scenarios.request: Make an illustrated fox wave; it must change paw poses, not slide across the frame.
scenarios.capabilities: Codex with an exposed still-image generation/editing tool; no video tool.
scenarios.expected: Check available schema, request coherent distinct poses or a sheet, preserve source, inspect actual frame content, assemble and review; do not infer video capability.
scenarios.observed_walkthrough: ai-artwork.md explicitly distinguishes whole-image transforms from articulated poses and requires observed sheet/grid verification before extraction.

scenarios.capabilities: No suitable image provider is exposed.
scenarios.expected: Explain missing capability; offer planning or supplied art; procedural graphics only if intent matches, without claiming generated poses.
scenarios.observed_walkthrough: ai-artwork.md forbids invented provider availability, implicit provider installs, and substituting a translated still for articulated artwork.

scenarios.capabilities: An image tool exists, but the loaded create-sprites workflow documents only an OpenCode provider.
scenarios.expected: Honor the loaded pixel-art workflow's provider boundary, explain the concrete mismatch, and offer planning/supplied frames.
scenarios.observed_walkthrough: ai-artwork.md explicitly handles narrower verified provider support in create-sprites rather than assuming tool equivalence from product names.

scenarios.request: Gently zoom my single illustration in a loop; no character pose changes needed.
scenarios.capabilities: Supplied still and available project-local image processing.
scenarios.expected: Use explicit static-image transforms, preserve source, review loop transition, and describe static-image motion honestly.
scenarios.observed_walkthrough: Motion and frame construction allows zoom/translation/effects for a still while separating pose changes; delivery requires accurate route labeling.

limitations: No image provider was called and no spending was incurred.
No model routing reliability or animation quality is established by this walkthrough.
Actual tool availability and generation approval must be checked when the workflow is used.
